mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND u.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.role_code = 'ENTERPRISE_ADMIN' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND r.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND r.role_code = 'ENTERPRISE_ADMIN' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.created_at
